text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“U.A.F. Athlete Memory”— A new PR project 
for the U.A.F. has been launched.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The athlete Umamusume competing in the 
meet will talk about how they discovered 
their current sports and share memories 
from when they ran races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through the video, fans learned about the 
current state of the Umamusume they had 
cheered on in races, and moved by this, 
they began to take an interest in the 
U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The U.A.F. is a new stage where Umamusume 
can shine, and a place reconnecting 
athletes with their fans— Ryoka Tsurugi 
shared that this realization had struck 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A path to increasing public interest in 
the U.A.F. had opened up. For now, the 
focus is to charge headlong toward the 2nd 
Stage!
